items.exampleEn: The old train moves leisurely through the green hills.
items.exampleZh: 那列老火車悠閒地穿過綠色的山丘。

items.exampleEn: The attractiveness of the offer made it hard to say no.
items.exampleZh: 這個提議太吸引人，讓人很難拒絕。

items.exampleEn: With perseverance, she finally passed the driving test.
items.exampleZh: 憑著毅力，她終於通過了駕照考試。

items.exampleEn: There was a feeling of unease in the room before the results came out.
items.exampleZh: 結果揭曉前，房間裡瀰漫著一股不安。

items.exampleEn: It is distressing to hear people shouting at each other.
items.exampleZh: 聽到人們互相吼叫令人難受。
items.glossZh: 令人痛苦的；令人苦惱的

items.exampleEn: Our dog has a carefree life; he sleeps and plays all day.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的狗過得無憂無慮，整天只管睡覺和玩耍。

items.exampleEn: The singer's haunting voice stayed with me for days.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手縈繞人心的歌聲在我腦中迴盪了好幾天。

items.exampleEn: "I-I-I don't know the answer," she stammered.
items.exampleZh: 「我、我、我不知道答案。」她結結巴巴地說。

items.sentenceEn: She tends to stammer when she is nervous.
items.sentenceZh: 她緊張的時候容易結巴。

items.audioEn: We had a leisurely breakfast on the balcony and didn't leave the hotel until noon.
items.audioZh: 我們在陽台上悠閒地吃早餐，一直到中午才離開飯店。
items.questionZh: 他們什麼時候離開飯店？
options: In the middle of the day

items.sentenceEn: Running a marathon takes months of perseverance.
items.sentenceZh: 跑一場馬拉松需要好幾個月的毅力。

items.sentenceEn: As a child, I spent carefree days fishing in the river.
items.sentenceZh: 小時候，我在河邊釣魚，度過無憂無慮的日子。

items.stemEn: Learning a new language takes time and ____.
items.stemZh: 學一種新語言需要時間和毅力。

items.stemEn: Losing her grandmother's ring was a ____ experience for her.
items.stemZh: 弄丟祖母的戒指對她來說是一段痛苦的經歷。

items.passageEn: Every summer, my family rents a small house in a fishing village. Our days there are carefree: we take leisurely walks along the coastline and eat fresh fish every night. Part of the village's attractiveness is its quiet. But this year, we felt a strange unease on our first night, when we heard a haunting song coming from the empty house next door. The next morning, a fisherman explained that his son practices the flute there every evening. We all laughed.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我們家都會在一個漁村租一間小房子。我們在那裡的日子無憂無慮：沿著海岸線悠閒地散步，每晚吃新鮮的魚。這個村子的魅力之一就是它的寧靜。但今年第一晚，我們聽到隔壁空屋傳來一首縈繞人心的歌，心裡感到一陣奇怪的不安。隔天早上，一位漁夫解釋說，他兒子每天傍晚都在那裡練習吹笛子。我們全都笑了。

questions.questionZh: 第一晚他們為什麼感到不安？
options: 房子裡突然停電了好久

questions.questionZh: 那首歌其實是怎麼回事？

items.promptZh: 他緊張得結結巴巴地說了聲謝謝。
referenceEn: He was so nervous that he stammered a thank-you.
He stammered his thanks because he was so nervous.
rubricZh: 要用 stammer（例如 stammered a thank-you、stammered his thanks）
「緊張得…」可寫，例如 so nervous that…、because he was nervous 等
時態合理即可（例如 stammered、stammers 等）

items.promptZh: 考完試之後，學生們看起來既輕鬆又無憂無慮。
referenceEn: After the exam, the students looked relaxed and carefree.
The students looked happy and carefree after the exam.
rubricZh: carefree 當形容詞，接在 look 等動詞後（例如 looked relaxed and carefree 等）
「輕鬆」可寫，例如 relaxed、happy 等；「考完試之後」放句首或句尾都可以
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 looked、look 等）
